# Synapse Network

Synapse Network is an agent-first settlement layer for AI agents. The primary product goal is: agent completed first paid invocation autonomously.

## Start Here

- docs/AGENTS.md - canonical workspace rules, product doctrine, architecture invariants, security baseline, and instruction layering
- docs/README.md - full documentation map and recommended reading order
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md - top-level architecture summary across runtime, settlement, control plane, and provider systems
- docs/Harness_engineering.md - repository-level AI collaboration and documentation landing plan

## Important Boundaries

- gateway is the runtime and settlement chain-offload control point
- contracts is the on-chain vault and settlement boundary
- gateway-admin is the admin control-plane backend, not a second runtime gateway
- admin-front is the admin control-plane UI
- provider_service is a provider runtime sample, not a settlement service
- frontend is the owner and developer facing product console

## Finance-Sensitive Work

For any money movement, settlement, approval, withdrawal review, refund, or reconciliation change, always read:

- docs/AGENTS.md
- .github/instructions/finance-backend.instructions.md
- .github/instructions/finance-admin.instructions.md when the task touches admin finance control-plane flows

## Validation Anchors

- root CI wrappers live in package.json under ci:* scripts
- project-local validation commands are summarized in docs/06_Reference/Validation_Entry_Points.md

## Planning

- use docs/exec-plans/templates/Exec_Plan_Template.md for new multi-step work
- store in-progress work under docs/exec-plans/active/
- move finished plans to docs/exec-plans/completed/
